instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a frisbee game in a grassy park. In the foreground, the large bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) ducks forward defensively with both hands raised. Behind him, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) and the Black woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stand with their arms raised, shouting and cheering. To the right, the woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) stands holding a red frisbee, watching the action. Bright natural daylight illuminates the green grass and trees.
